mapper.select: select dept_id companyDeptId,dept_name companyName from sys_dept where parent_id=100 and del_flag='0' and status='0' order by order_num,dept_id

select category_id categoryId,category_code categoryCode,category_name categoryName,fact_kind factKind, default_sign defaultSign,unit_type unitType from biz_fact_category where status='0' order by sort_order,category_id

select p.project_id projectId,p.project_no projectNo,p.project_name projectName,p.company_dept_id companyDeptId, d.dept_name companyName,p.accounting_mode accountingMode,p.base_currency currency,p.initiator_name initiatorName from biz_project p left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.company_dept_id and d.del_flag='0' where p.del_flag='0' and p.status not in('CANCELED') and coalesce(p.sponsor_owner_user_id,p.initiator_user_id)=#{userId} order by d.order_num,p.project_name

select count(distinct p.project_id) from biz_project p join biz_project_staff_allocation a on a.project_id=p.project_id and a.status='ACTIVE' and a.effective_from<=#{bizDate} and (a.effective_to is null or a.effective_to>=#{bizDate}) where p.del_flag='0' and p.status not in('CLOSED','CANCELED') and coalesce(p.sponsor_owner_user_id,p.initiator_user_id)=#{userId} and not exists(select 1 from biz_project_daily_result r where r.project_id=p.project_id and r.biz_date=#{bizDate} and r.is_current='1')

select category_id categoryId,category_code categoryCode,category_name categoryName,fact_kind factKind, default_sign defaultSign,unit_type unitType from biz_fact_category where category_code=#{categoryCode} and status='0' limit 1

select fact_id factId,project_id projectId,company_dept_id companyDeptId,biz_date bizDate,category_id categoryId, category_code categoryCode,category_name categoryName,fact_kind factKind,amount,quantity,currency,unit, description,counterparty,attachment_urls attachmentUrls,source_domain sourceDomain,source_type sourceType, source_id sourceId,source_line_key sourceLineKey,status,reversal_fact_id reversalFactId,idempotency_key idempotencyKey, version,confirmed_user_id confirmedUserId,confirmed_user_name confirmedUserName,confirmed_time confirmedTime, create_user_id createUserId,create_by createBy,create_time createTime,update_by updateBy,update_time updateTime,remark from biz_operating_fact where project_id=#{projectId} and biz_date=#{bizDate} and source_type='DAILY_TOTAL' and status='CONFIRMED' order by fact_id desc limit 1

select project_id projectId,project_name projectName,company_dept_id companyDeptId,accounting_mode accountingMode, base_currency currency,budget_limit budgetLimit, coalesce(sponsor_owner_user_id,initiator_user_id) initiatorUserId, coalesce(sponsor_owner_name,initiator_name) initiatorName, main_owner_user_id mainOwnerUserId,main_owner_name mainOwnerName,status from biz_project where project_id=#{projectId} and del_flag='0' limit 1

mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when fact_kind='REVENUE' then amount else 0 end),0) revenueAmount, coalesce(sum(case when fact_kind='COST' and category_code<>'PROJECT_BONUS_COST' then amount else 0 end),0) costAmount, coalesce(sum(case when fact_kind='COST' and category_code='PROJECT_BONUS_COST' then amount else 0 end),0) bonusCost, coalesce(sum(case when fact_kind='ADJUSTMENT' then amount else 0 end),0) adjustmentAmount, coalesce(sum(case when fact_kind='VALUE' then coalesce(quantity,amount,0) else 0 end),0) valueScore from biz_operating_fact where project_id=#{projectId} and biz_date=#{bizDate} and status in('CONFIRMED','REVERSED')

select coalesce(sum(case when leave_record.leave_id is not null then 0 when a.allocation_mode='PERCENTAGE' and c.cost_mode='DAILY' then c.unit_cost*coalesce(e.actual_percent,a.allocation_value)/100 when a.allocation_mode='PERCENTAGE' and c.cost_mode='MONTHLY' then c.unit_cost/c.standard_work_days*coalesce(e.actual_percent,a.allocation_value)/100 when a.allocation_mode='PERCENTAGE' and c.cost_mode='HOURLY' then c.unit_cost*8*coalesce(e.actual_percent,a.allocation_value)/100 when a.allocation_mode='FIXED_DAILY' then a.allocation_value when a.allocation_mode='HOURS' and c.cost_mode='HOURLY' then c.unit_cost*a.allocation_value when a.allocation_mode='ATTENDANCE' and c.cost_mode='DAILY' then c.unit_cost*a.allocation_value when a.allocation_mode='PER_TASK' and c.cost_mode='FIXED_TASK' then c.unit_cost*a.allocation_value else 0 end),0) from biz_project_staff_allocation a join biz_staff_cost_policy c on c.user_id=a.user_id and c.status='ACTIVE' and c.effective_from<=#{bizDate} and (c.effective_to is null or c.effective_to>=#{bizDate}) left join biz_project_effort_report e on e.project_id=a.project_id and e.user_id=a.user_id and e.biz_date=#{bizDate} and e.report_status='CONFIRMED' left join biz_staff_leave leave_record on leave_record.user_id=a.user_id and leave_record.leave_date=#{bizDate} and leave_record.status='ACTIVE' where a.project_id=#{projectId} and a.status='ACTIVE' and a.effective_from<=#{bizDate} and (a.effective_to is null or a.effective_to>=#{bizDate})

select a.user_id userId,a.user_name componentName,c.country_region_snapshot countryRegion, c.unit_cost monthlyCost,c.currency,c.standard_work_days standardWorkDays, round(c.unit_cost/nullif(c.standard_work_days,0),4) dailyCost, a.allocation_value plannedPercent,e.actual_percent actualPercent, coalesce(e.actual_percent,a.allocation_value) appliedPercent, case when leave_record.leave_id is not null then 'LEAVE' when e.effort_id is not null then 'ACTUAL' else 'PLAN' end inputSource, leave_record.leave_type leaveType, case when leave_record.leave_id is not null then 0 when a.allocation_mode='PERCENTAGE' and c.cost_mode='DAILY' then c.unit_cost*coalesce(e.actual_percent,a.allocation_value)/100 when a.allocation_mode='PERCENTAGE' and c.cost_mode='MONTHLY' then c.unit_cost/c.standard_work_days*coalesce(e.actual_percent,a.allocation_value)/100 when a.allocation_mode='PERCENTAGE' and c.cost_mode='HOURLY' then c.unit_cost*8*coalesce(e.actual_percent,a.allocation_value)/100 when a.allocation_mode='FIXED_DAILY' then a.allocation_value when a.allocation_mode='HOURS' and c.cost_mode='HOURLY' then c.unit_cost*a.allocation_value when a.allocation_mode='ATTENDANCE' and c.cost_mode='DAILY' then c.unit_cost*a.allocation_value when a.allocation_mode='PER_TASK' and c.cost_mode='FIXED_TASK' then c.unit_cost*a.allocation_value else 0 end amount, case when leave_record.leave_id is not null then concat('今日请假（',leave_record.leave_type,'），不计人员成本') when a.allocation_mode='PERCENTAGE' then concat( case when e.effort_id is not null then '已确认实际投入 ' else '计划投入 ' end, cast(coalesce(e.actual_percent,a.allocation_value) as char),'%；', case c.cost_mode when 'MONTHLY' then concat('月度用人成本 ',cast(c.unit_cost as char),' / ',cast(c.standard_work_days as char),' 天（', case c.country_region_snapshot when 'VN' then '越南' when 'CN' then '中国' else c.country_region_snapshot end,'）') when 'DAILY' then concat('日成本 ',cast(c.unit_cost as char)) when 'HOURLY' then concat('时成本 ',cast(c.unit_cost as char),' × 8 小时') else concat('成本单价 ',cast(c.unit_cost as char)) end) when a.allocation_mode='FIXED_DAILY' then concat('项目固定日成本 ',cast(a.allocation_value as char)) when a.allocation_mode='HOURS' then concat(cast(a.allocation_value as char),' 小时 × 时成本 ',cast(c.unit_cost as char)) when a.allocation_mode='ATTENDANCE' then concat(cast(a.allocation_value as char),' 人天 × 日成本 ',cast(c.unit_cost as char)) when a.allocation_mode='PER_TASK' then concat(cast(a.allocation_value as char),' 项任务 × 单项成本 ',cast(c.unit_cost as char)) else '当前投入方式未产生人员成本' end calculationDetail from biz_project_staff_allocation a join biz_staff_cost_policy c on c.user_id=a.user_id and c.status='ACTIVE' and c.effective_from<=#{bizDate} and (c.effective_to is null or c.effective_to>=#{bizDate}) left join biz_project_effort_report e on e.project_id=a.project_id and e.user_id=a.user_id and e.biz_date=#{bizDate} and e.report_status='CONFIRMED' left join biz_staff_leave leave_record on leave_record.user_id=a.user_id and leave_record.leave_date=#{bizDate} and leave_record.status='ACTIVE' where a.project_id=#{projectId} and a.status='ACTIVE' and a.effective_from<=#{bizDate} and (a.effective_to is null or a.effective_to>=#{bizDate}) order by a.user_name,a.user_id
select coalesce(max(result_version),0)+1 from biz_project_daily_result where project_id=#{projectId} and biz_date=#{bizDate}
mapper.update: update biz_project_daily_result set is_current='0' where project_id=#{projectId} and biz_date=#{bizDate} and is_current='1'
mapper.select: select item_id itemId,result_id resultId,component_code componentCode,component_name componentName,amount,quantity, calculation_detail calculationDetail from biz_project_daily_result_item where result_id=#{resultId} order by item_id
select count(*) from biz_operating_fact f join biz_project p on p.project_id=f.project_id and p.del_flag='0' where f.status='DRAFT' and coalesce(p.sponsor_owner_user_id,p.initiator_user_id)=#{userId}

select * from ( select 'LOSS' alertType,r.project_id projectId,p.project_name projectName,p.company_dept_id companyDeptId, d.dept_name companyName,r.biz_date bizDate,r.profit_amount amount, concat('当日经营结果为 ',round(r.profit_amount,2)) alertMessage,1 sortOrder from biz_project_daily_result r join biz_project p on p.project_id=r.project_id and p.del_flag='0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.company_dept_id where r.is_current='1' and r.biz_date=#{bizDate} and r.profit_amount<0 and coalesce(p.sponsor_owner_user_id,p.initiator_user_id)=#{userId} union all select 'OVER_BUDGET',r.project_id,p.project_name,p.company_dept_id,d.dept_name,r.biz_date, r.budget_spent,concat('累计成本 ',round(r.budget_spent,2),' 已超过预算 ',round(p.budget_limit,2)),2 from biz_project_daily_result r join biz_project p on p.project_id=r.project_id and p.del_flag='0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.company_dept_id where r.is_current='1' and r.biz_date=#{bizDate} and p.budget_limit is not null and r.budget_spent>p.budget_limit and coalesce(p.sponsor_owner_user_id,p.initiator_user_id)=#{userId} union all select 'MISSING_COMPANY',p.project_id,p.project_name,null,null,#{bizDate},null,'项目尚未设置归属公司，无法录入收支',3 from biz_project p where p.del_flag='0' and p.company_dept_id is null and p.status not in('CLOSED','CANCELED') and coalesce(p.sponsor_owner_user_id,p.initiator_user_id)=#{userId} ) alerts order by sortOrder,projectName limit 20

select r.project_id projectId,p.project_name projectName,p.company_dept_id companyDeptId,d.dept_name companyName, sum(r.revenue_amount) revenueAmount,sum(r.cost_amount) businessCost,sum(r.personnel_cost) personnelCost, sum(r.bonus_cost) bonusCost,sum(r.cost_amount+r.personnel_cost+r.bonus_cost) costAmount, sum(r.adjustment_amount) adjustmentAmount,sum(r.profit_amount) profitAmount,max(r.data_cutoff_time) dataCutoffTime from biz_project_daily_result r join biz_project p on p.project_id=r.project_id and p.del_flag='0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.company_dept_id where r.is_current='1' and r.biz_date between #{dateFrom} and #{dateTo} and coalesce(p.sponsor_owner_user_id,p.initiator_user_id)=#{userId} group by r.project_id,p.project_name,p.company_dept_id,d.dept_name order by profitAmount desc,r.project_id limit 10

select r.company_dept_id companyDeptId,d.dept_name companyName,sum(r.revenue_amount) revenueAmount, sum(r.cost_amount) businessCost,sum(r.personnel_cost) personnelCost,sum(r.bonus_cost) bonusCost, sum(r.cost_amount+r.personnel_cost+r.bonus_cost) costAmount,sum(r.adjustment_amount) adjustmentAmount, sum(r.profit_amount) profitAmount,count(distinct r.project_id) projectCount,max(r.data_cutoff_time) dataCutoffTime from biz_project_daily_result r join biz_project p on p.project_id=r.project_id and p.del_flag='0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=r.company_dept_id where r.is_current='1' and r.biz_date between #{dateFrom} and #{dateTo} and coalesce(p.sponsor_owner_user_id,p.initiator_user_id)=#{userId} group by r.company_dept_id,d.dept_name order by r.company_dept_id

select p.project_id projectId,p.project_name projectName,p.company_dept_id companyDeptId, company.dept_name companyName,m.user_id userId,m.user_name_snapshot userName,m.member_role memberRole, profile.country_region profileCountryRegion, coalesce(c.country_region_snapshot,profile.country_region, case when vietnam.dept_id is not null then 'VN' else 'CN' end) countryRegion, c.policy_id policyId,c.unit_cost monthlyCost,c.currency,c.standard_work_days standardWorkDays, round(c.unit_cost/nullif(c.standard_work_days,0),4) dailyCost, a.allocation_id allocationId,a.allocation_value plannedPercent,e.actual_percent actualPercent, coalesce(e.actual_percent,a.allocation_value) appliedPercent, coalesce(total_plan.total_planned_percent,0) totalPlannedPercent, case when leave_record.leave_id is not null then 'LEAVE' when e.effort_id is not null then 'ACTUAL' else 'PLAN' end inputSource, leave_record.leave_type leaveType, case when leave_record.leave_id is not null then 0 when c.cost_mode='MONTHLY' and c.currency='CNY' and a.allocation_mode='PERCENTAGE' then round(c.unit_cost/nullif(c.standard_work_days,0)*coalesce(e.actual_percent,a.allocation_value)/100,4) else 0 end personnelCost, case when profile.country_region is null or profile.country_region not in ('CN','VN') then 'MISSING_REGION' when c.policy_id is null then 'MISSING_COST' when c.cost_mode<>'MONTHLY' or c.currency<>'CNY' or c.standard_work_days is null then 'LEGACY_COST' when a.allocation_id is null then 'MISSING_ALLOCATION' when coalesce(total_plan.total_planned_percent,0)>100 then 'OVER_ALLOCATED' when leave_record.leave_id is not null then 'LEAVE' else 'READY' end costStatus from biz_project p join biz_project_member m on m.project_id=p.project_id and m.status='0' and m.member_role<>'OBSERVER' left join sys_dept company on company.dept_id=p.company_dept_id and company.del_flag='0' left join sys_user staff_user on staff_user.user_id=m.user_id and staff_user.del_flag='0' left join biz_staff_profile profile on profile.user_id=m.user_id left join sys_dept staff_dept on staff_dept.dept_id=staff_user.dept_id and staff_dept.del_flag='0' left join sys_dept vietnam on vietnam.dept_name='越南meimaru公司' and vietnam.del_flag='0' and (vietnam.dept_id=staff_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(vietnam.dept_id,staff_dept.ancestors)) left join biz_project_staff_allocation a on a.project_id=p.project_id and a.user_id=m.user_id and a.status='ACTIVE' and a.allocation_mode='PERCENTAGE' and a.effective_from<=#{bizDate} and (a.effective_to is null or a.effective_to>=#{bizDate}) left join biz_staff_cost_policy c on c.user_id=m.user_id and c.status='ACTIVE' and c.effective_from<=#{bizDate} and (c.effective_to is null or c.effective_to>=#{bizDate}) left join biz_project_effort_report e on e.project_id=p.project_id and e.user_id=m.user_id and e.biz_date=#{bizDate} and e.report_status='CONFIRMED' left join biz_staff_leave leave_record on leave_record.user_id=m.user_id and leave_record.leave_date=#{bizDate} and leave_record.status='ACTIVE' left join ( select a2.user_id,sum(a2.allocation_value) total_planned_percent from biz_project_staff_allocation a2 join biz_project p2 on p2.project_id=a2.project_id and p2.del_flag='0' and p2.status not in('CLOSED','CANCELED') where a2.status='ACTIVE' and a2.allocation_mode='PERCENTAGE' and a2.effective_from<=#{bizDate} and (a2.effective_to is null or a2.effective_to>=#{bizDate}) and coalesce(p2.sponsor_owner_user_id,p2.initiator_user_id)=#{userId} group by a2.user_id ) total_plan on total_plan.user_id=m.user_id where p.del_flag='0' and p.status not in('CLOSED','CANCELED') and coalesce(p.sponsor_owner_user_id,p.initiator_user_id)=#{userId} and p.project_id=#{projectId} and p.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} order by field(costStatus,'MISSING_COST','LEGACY_COST','MISSING_ALLOCATION','OVER_ALLOCATED','READY','LEAVE'), p.project_name,m.user_name_snapshot,m.user_id

select u.user_id userId,coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name) userName, company.dept_id companyDeptId,company.dept_name companyName,profile.country_region profileCountryRegion, case when profile.country_region is null or profile.country_region not in ('CN','VN') then 'MISSING_REGION' when valid_cost.user_id is not null then 'READY' when any_cost.user_id is not null then 'LEGACY_COST' else 'MISSING_COST' end costStatus, count(distinct project.project_id) projectCount, group_concat(distinct project.project_name order by project.project_name separator '、') projectNameText from sys_user u join sys_dept staff_dept on staff_dept.dept_id=u.dept_id and staff_dept.del_flag='0' join sys_dept company on company.parent_id=100 and company.del_flag='0' and company.status='0' and (company.dept_id=staff_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(company.dept_id,staff_dept.ancestors)) left join biz_staff_profile profile on profile.user_id=u.user_id left join ( select user_id from biz_staff_cost_policy where status='ACTIVE' and effective_from<=#{bizDate} and (effective_to is null or effective_to>=#{bizDate}) group by user_id ) any_cost on any_cost.user_id=u.user_id left join ( select user_id from biz_staff_cost_policy where status='ACTIVE' and cost_mode='MONTHLY' and currency='CNY' and standard_work_days is not null and standard_work_days>0 and effective_from<=#{bizDate} and (effective_to is null or effective_to>=#{bizDate}) group by user_id ) valid_cost on valid_cost.user_id=u.user_id left join biz_project_member member on member.user_id=u.user_id and member.status='0' and member.member_role<>'OBSERVER' left join biz_project project on project.project_id=member.project_id and project.del_flag='0' and project.status not in('CLOSED','CANCELED') where u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' and coalesce(profile.employment_status,'ACTIVE')<>'LEFT' and company.leader_user_id=#{userId} group by u.user_id,u.nick_name,u.user_name,company.dept_id,company.dept_name,profile.country_region, valid_cost.user_id,any_cost.user_id having costStatus<>'READY' order by company.order_num,field(costStatus,'MISSING_REGION','MISSING_COST','LEGACY_COST'),userName,u.user_id
